# Season Shelf 1.2.8

- Added GitHub-inspired light and dark colours, with blue navigation, green primary actions and distinct download status colours. System theme and saved custom appearance settings are preserved.
- Fixed download publication overwriting existing temporary transfer paths.
- Updated Electron and vulnerable dependencies.
- Improved local file verification with larger buffered reads. Local measurements showed about 11% faster verification; Telegram network download speed is unchanged by this optimisation.

Windows installations can update from within the app. On macOS, download the universal DMG and replace the app in Applications. Builds remain unsigned, and the macOS build is not notarized.
